answer: Apprenticeship cohorts bind each agent identity to a verifiable training lineage, so a sybil swarm must replicate genuine instruction history rather than minting hollow profiles from cheap shale-like keypairs. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
